proposal.expected_benefit: This enhancement will improve the system's ability to detect and respond to audit anchor failures in real-time, thereby maintaining audit integrity and preventing unauthorized actions.
proposal.problem: The current defense strategy does not explicitly include real-time monitoring and logging of audit anchor status, which could leave gaps in detecting and responding to audit anchor failures.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement real-time monitoring and logging of audit anchor status to ensure continuous visibility into audit integrity. This will allow for immediate detection of audit anchor failures and enable timely mitigation actions.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-Time Monitoring and Logging of Audit Anchor Status
verification_tests: Verify real-time audit anchor status monitoring is enabled
Validate logging of audit anchor status changes
Test response time to audit anchor failure detection
